newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa futures called to open flat to $5 lower.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa futures called to open flat to $5 lower.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures were called to open unchanged to $5 a tonne lower Tuesday, on the heels of a weak performance in London overnight, traders said.
London cocoa futures softened in early rangebound dealings Tuesday, with benchmark LIFFE March down three stg a tonne at the midday break, to 934 stg. Spot December was off five stg at 900 stg.

New York cocoa futures ended firmer Monday in uneventful trade. March cocoa rose $6 a tonne on the day, to $1,383, after ranging narrowly between $1,388 and $1,380. Spot December gained $4, at $1,337, while the rest ended $5 to $8 higher.
